combo.title: UNSTOPPABLE!
combo.subtitle: WINTER HAS COME
combo.desc: 7 fast choices — faster than George can backspace.

combo.title: ULTRAAAA COMBOOOOO!
combo.subtitle: A DREAM OF SPRING
combo.desc: 8+ consecutive choices! The manuscript is written!

plotholes.title: KNOT UNTIED // ESSOS ABANDONED
plotholes.subtitle: 400 PAGES OF MEEREEN DESTROYED IN 3 PARAGRAPHS
plotholes.desc: Bypassed 15 years of Slaver's Bay trade tariffs by burning the blockade and sailing directly to Westeros.

plotholes.title: HE FINALLY PICKED UP // HOWLAND REED
plotholes.subtitle: ROWED OUT OF THE BOG AFTER 28 YEARS
plotholes.desc: Forced Howland Reed to leave Greywater Watch with the marriage certificate and Lyanna's harp.

plotholes.title: THE WORST ASSASSIN IN HISTORY
plotholes.subtitle: WHY DID HE HAVE VALYRIAN STEEL?!
plotholes.desc: Confronted the nonsensical logic of hiring a homeless hitman with an irreplaceable priceless heirloom.

plotholes.title: THE FIVE YEAR TIME-SKIP
plotholes.subtitle: ARYA IS FINALLY AN ADULT
plotholes.desc: Restored George's original time-skip so teenagers aren't commanding planetary wars.

plotholes.title: THE SILENT ROPE // CATELYN STARK
plotholes.subtitle: RESOLVED JAIME'S 2011 CLIFFHANGER
plotholes.desc: Concluded the 15-year standoff between Lady Stoneheart, Brienne of Tarth, and Jaime Lannister.

plotholes.title: WHAT IS DEAD MAY SUMMON SQUID
plotholes.subtitle: BLOOD MAGIC OFF THE REDWYNE STRAITS
plotholes.desc: Unleashed the kraken Euron spent two whole books hyping up.

plotholes.title: MERE FLESH WOUND // 'OH.'
plotholes.subtitle: QUENTYN MARTELL WAS WEARING FIREPROOF OINTMENT
plotholes.desc: Addressed the Dorne plotline where the prince flew across the world just to turn into charcoal.

plotholes.title: THE MUMMER'S DRAGON REVEALED
plotholes.subtitle: BLACKFYRE PATERNITY TEST RESULTS ARE IN
plotholes.desc: Exposed Illyrio Mopatis and Varys's secret Blackfyre conspiracy once and for all.

plotholes.title: KNOT UNTIED // ESSOS ABANDONED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE MEEREENESE KNOT
plotholes.desc: George spent 11 years trying to coordinate 6 POV characters arriving in Slaver's Bay, only to have Dany fly away on Drogon before speaking to a single one of them.

plotholes.title: HE FINALLY PICKED UP // HOWLAND REED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: HOWLAND REED'S COMPLETE ABSENCE
plotholes.desc: The only living human who survived the Tower of Joy has spent 28 years floating in a swamp castle refusing to answer any raven while the realm burns.

plotholes.title: THE WORST ASSASSIN IN HISTORY
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE CATSPAW VALYRIAN STEEL DAGGER
plotholes.desc: Handing an irreplaceable, priceless Valyrian steel dagger to a random transient to assassinate the son of the Warden of the North inside his own castle.

plotholes.title: THE FIVE YEAR TIME-SKIP
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE SCRAPPED 5-YEAR TIME SKIP
plotholes.desc: Cancelling the time-skip meant Arya is a master Faceless assassin at 11, Jon commands the continent at 16, and the dragons grew overnight on vibes.

plotholes.title: THE SILENT ROPE // CATELYN STARK
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: LADY STONEHEART & JAIME'S DISAPPEARANCE
plotholes.desc: One of the most dramatic cliffhangers in fantasy literature left Jaime and Brienne standing before an undead Catelyn Stark for over 15 years.

plotholes.title: WHAT IS DEAD MAY SUMMON SQUID
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: EURON'S VALYRIAN ARMOR & ELDRITCH SQUID
plotholes.desc: Euron suddenly shows up with an artifact that no Targaryen dragonlord in 5,000 years could afford, preparing to summon literal Cthulhu off Oldtown.

plotholes.title: THE MUMMER'S DRAGON REVEALED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: YOUNG GRIFF / FAEGON'S SUDDEN EXISTENCE
plotholes.desc: A completely unmentioned secret heir to the Iron Throne casually floats down a river with blue hair in Book 5, rendering the entire War of 5 Kings redundant.

plotholes.title: THE WILDFIRE GAMBIT
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE UNEXPLODED WILDFIRE UNDER KING'S LANDING
plotholes.plotHole: The Unexploded Wildfire Under King's Landing
plotholes.desc: The entire city has lived on top of volatile explosive barrels for 20 years, while Cersei drinks wine directly above them.

plotholes.title: WHAT IS DEAD MAY NEVER DIE // TSUNAMI OF THE DEEP
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE DAMPHAIR'S SURVIVAL
plotholes.desc: Aeron survived drinking seawater for 20 years, proving either divine intervention or extraordinary ironborn kidney function.

plotholes.title: THE SPEAR AND THE DRAGON // DORNISH ALLIANCE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE DORNISH BLACKFYRE ALLIANCE
plotholes.desc: Doran Martell had secret marriage contracts with every Targaryen in existence and managed to marry off zero of them.

plotholes.title: STORMLANDS RECKONING // ELEPHANTS AT GRIFFIN'S ROOST
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: ARIANNE MEETS YOUNG GRIFF IN TWOW
plotholes.plotHole: Arianne Meets Young Griff in TWOW
plotholes.desc: Princess Arianne spent two whole sample chapters riding mules through the rainwood just to look at an elephant.

plotholes.title: MERCY // NEEDLEWORK AT THE MUMMER'S TROUPE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE MERCY TWOW CHAPTER
plotholes.desc: Arya recited needlework quotes from Book 1 while playing a mummery maiden in Braavos just to slit a Lannister guard's femoral artery.

plotholes.title: THE QUEEN OF WOLVES // HOMEWARD BOUND
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: NYMERIA'S SUPER-PACK PURPOSE
plotholes.desc: An army of giant feral direwolves has been terrorizing the Riverlands off-screen for four books without ever being addressed.

plotholes.title: THE WHITE BULL'S CHARGE // BATTLE OF FIRE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE BATTLE OF FIRE IN TWOW
plotholes.plotHole: The Battle of Fire in TWOW
plotholes.desc: An eighty-year-old knight in white plate riding a blind silver mare is the only competent military commander in Essos.

plotholes.title: AN OLD KNIGHT AND AN IRON REAVER
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: BARRISTAN AND VICTARION MEETING
plotholes.desc: The purest chivalric knight in the realm and the dumbest pirate alive trying to negotiate a military alliance.

plotholes.title: SWIMMING UNDER THE WATER GATE // THE BLACKFISH
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE BLACKFISH'S ESCAPE FROM RIVERRUN
plotholes.desc: An elderly warrior swam miles down the Red Fork under water gates and vanished completely into thin air.

plotholes.title: THE THOUSAND EYES AND ONE // BRYNDEN RIVERS
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: BLOODRAVEN'S ULTIMATE PLAN
plotholes.desc: A 125-year-old Targaryen sorcerer with a tree growing through his eye socket is somehow trusted as a reliable mentor.

plotholes.title: THE IRON BANK'S WRIT // GOLD IN THE BLIZZARD
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE IRON BANK'S STANNIS INVESTMENT
plotholes.desc: Tycho Nestoris walked 500 leagues through 10-foot drifts in velvet slippers just to collect Cersei's defaulted credit card debt.

plotholes.title: THE WEIRWOOD PASTE // RED SEED SACRAMENT
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE JOJEN PASTE THEORY CONFIRMED
plotholes.desc: Jojen disappeared right when the Children offered a bowl of red-veined porridge that tastes like blood and awakens tree telepathy.

plotholes.title: THE GIANT IN STONE ARMOR // SER ROBERT STRONG
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: SER ROBERT STRONG'S IDENTITY
plotholes.desc: Qyburn sent Gregor's skull to Dorne, yet a headless zombie knight is running around the Red Keep refusing to take off his helm.

plotholes.title: THE VALONQAR // HANDS OF GOLD
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE VALONQAR PROPHECY FULFILLED
plotholes.desc: Cersei spent 30 years terrorizing Tyrion when the little brother prophecy could refer to Jaime, the Hound, or literally any younger sibling.

plotholes.title: THE BLOOD OF DRAGONS // THE LOST VALYRIAN ROLLS
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: HOW VALYRIAN STEEL IS FORGED
plotholes.desc: The grey sheep of Oldtown have spent 300 years poisoning dragons while pretending they're just humble scholars studying ravens.

plotholes.title: THE TOMBS OF KINGS // DRAGON EGGS UNDER ICE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE SECRETS OF WINTERFELL CRYPTS
plotholes.desc: Generations of Starks walked past ancient stone kings without ever checking behind the tomb for glowing reptile eggs.

plotholes.title: OF THE NIGHT // GEROLD DAYNE CORNERED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE HUNT FOR DARKSTAR IN TWOW
plotholes.plotHole: The Hunt for Darkstar in TWOW
plotholes.desc: The edgiest character in fantasy literature sliced off a little girl's ear, stole a horse, and vanished into the mountains.

plotholes.title: THE CANNIBAL ISLE // SKAGOSIAN UNICORNS
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: DAVOS ON SKAGOS / RICKON STARK
plotholes.desc: Osha took the four-year-old heir of Winterfell to an island infamous for eating people and riding woolly one-horned beasts.

plotholes.title: THE SWORD OF THE MORNING // LIGHTBRINGER'S SISTER
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE SIGNIFICANCE OF SWORD DAWN
plotholes.desc: A sword forged from a fallen meteor that is not Valyrian steel yet is sharper and paler than milk has sat in Starfall for 10,000 years.

plotholes.title: OVERRIPE FRUIT // WATER GARDENS UNMASKED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: DORAN MARTELL'S TRUE ENDGAME
plotholes.desc: Doran watched blood oranges fall and rot in the dirt for twenty years while all his secret allies died of natural causes.

plotholes.title: THE VERDANT FLAME // HATCHING IN THE SNOW
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE DRAGON OF WINTERFELL
plotholes.desc: Summer watched a massive fire beast rise from the castle ruins and nobody mentioned it again for five thousand pages.

plotholes.title: THE BINDING OF RHAEGAL // FIRE AND SEED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: DRAGONBINDER HORN BOUND A DRAGON
plotholes.desc: Euron brought a Valyrian hell-horn covered in glyphs that instantly turns anyone who touches their lips to it into burnt toast.

plotholes.title: THE WRATH OF OLD VALYRIA // THE HORN DRAGONBINDER
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: EURON'S ELDRITCH BLOOD MAGIC
plotholes.desc: Readers have spent a decade waiting to see if Euron actually summons Cthulhu or just crashes into rocks in expensive armor.

plotholes.title: THE PRICE OF FACES // THE CONTRACT OF THE HOOF
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE FACELESS MEN'S ULTIMATE MISSION
plotholes.desc: Slave assassins in the fourteen flames destroyed an entire global dragon empire, and now they take contracts for pennies.

plotholes.title: A COIN OF IRON // INFILTRATING KING'S LANDING
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: ARYA'S VENGEANCE LIST
plotholes.desc: Arya's bedtime death prayer has more names than the Westerosi census registry, and most of them died of random dysentery.

plotholes.title: THE GHOST OF WINTERFELL // THE CROUCHING HOOD
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: IDENTITY OF THE GHOST OF WINTERFELL
plotholes.plotHole: Identity of the Ghost of Winterfell
plotholes.desc: A castle packed with thousands of angry killers and half the dead men turned out to be done by five spearwives and Theon talking to trees.

plotholes.title: EPILOGUE // THE WORDSTAR 4.0 BACKSPACE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: WHY WINDS OF WINTER TOOK 15 YEARS
plotholes.plotHole: Why Winds of Winter Took 15 Years
plotholes.desc: Author uses a 1987 DOS machine with no internet and an infinite backspace key to write 300 pages of turnip stew.

plotholes.title: FIRE AT BAELOR // THE GREEN PYRE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE SEPT OF BAELOR WILDFIRE EXPLOSION
plotholes.plotHole: The Sept of Baelor Wildfire Explosion
plotholes.desc: Giving religious zealots military grade weaponry to save 200 silver stags is the most catastrophic administrative blunder in history.

plotholes.title: THE FLAME OF OBSIDIAN // CITADEL OBSERVATORY
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE GLASS CANDLES OF OLDTOWN
plotholes.desc: Leyton Hightower hasn't descended from his skyscraper in a decade while consulting sorcery books and ignoring the pirate fleet below.

plotholes.title: HOLD THE DOOR // SHATTERED TEMPORALITY
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE ORIGIN OF HODOR'S NAME
plotholes.desc: Bran psychically ruined a gentle stable boy's life across thirty years of space-time just to hold a wooden door.

plotholes.title: DOWN THE BLOODY GATE // LORDS OF THE MOUNTAIN
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE VALE KNIGHTS NORTHERN RELIEF
plotholes.desc: Twenty thousand heavy armored knights sat in a mountain fortress eating lemon cakes while the rest of the continent collapsed.

plotholes.title: THE SINGER OF DORNISH WIVES // ABEL UNMASKED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: MANCE RAYDER'S WINTERFELL INFILTRATION
plotholes.desc: The King-Beyond-the-Wall disguised himself as a traveling lute player to rescue Arya Stark because Melisandre used a ruby glamor.

plotholes.title: THE NORTH REMEMBERS // THREE PUDGY CRUSTS
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE MANDERLY FREY PIE CONSPIRACY
plotholes.desc: Lord Wyman served three human-meat pies to the Boltons while requesting the singer play The Rat Cook and asking for seconds.

plotholes.title: BONES IN THE FLAME // JON SNOW RISES
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: JON SNOW'S RESURRECTION IN THE BOOKS
plotholes.plotHole: Jon Snow's Resurrection in the Books
plotholes.desc: Jon has been lying face down in the snow bleeding out for fifteen real-life years while George attends conventions.

plotholes.title: CLEGANEBOWL // THE GRAVEDIGGER RISES
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: CLEGANEBOWL CONFIRMED
plotholes.desc: The hype for Cleganebowl reached thermonuclear proportions based on a limping monk petting a horse named Stranger.

plotholes.title: THE NIGHT LAMP // THE FROZEN LAKE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE BATTLE OF ICE / NIGHT LAMP THEORY
plotholes.plotHole: The Battle of Ice / Night Lamp Theory
plotholes.desc: Fans have spent 15 years writing 40,000-word essays analyzing medieval fishing beacons while Stannis starved in a blizzard.

plotholes.title: UNDER THE SEA // THE JESTER'S TRUTH
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: PATCHFACE'S PROPHETIC MADNESS
plotholes.desc: A brain-damaged court jester with tattooed bells predicted the Red Wedding and the drowned apocalypse in kindergarten rhymes.

plotholes.title: THE THIEF OF KEYS // THE PIG BOY'S FACE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: PATE / JAQEN H'GHAR IN OLDTOWN
plotholes.desc: The greatest assassin in the world went undercover as a pig-boy novice maester to steal an iron master key from a vault.

plotholes.title: THE HEIR APPARENT // SHAGGYDOG'S GROWL
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: RICKON STARK RETURNS TO THE NORTH
plotholes.plotHole: Rickon Stark Returns to the North
plotholes.desc: The youngest Stark brother has spent 15 real-time years surviving on an uncharted rock with a direwolf named Shaggydog.

plotholes.title: CHAOS IS NOT A LADDER // THE VALE DECLARES
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: LITTLEFINGER'S FALL IN THE VALE
plotholes.desc: Petyr Baelish's entire multi-decade geopolitical scheme hinged on a teenage girl never telling anyone who she actually was.

plotholes.title: THE BIRD UNCAGED // THE EYRIE'S TOURNEY
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: SANSA'S VALE POLITICAL MASTERCLASS
plotholes.desc: Sansa has been dyeing her auburn hair brown and pretending to be a bastard girl while running an entire feudal province.

plotholes.title: THE STONE MEN OF SKAGOS // ANCIENT SACRIFICE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: SKAGOSI LOYALTY SECURED
plotholes.desc: The entire Northern fleet avoids Skagos because of rumors started by drunken sailors five hundred years ago.

plotholes.title: THE TOWER LEAP // EIGHTY FEET OF SNOW
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE ESCAPE FROM WINTERFELL
plotholes.desc: Jumping off eighty-foot stone battlements into snowdrifts without breaking every bone in your body violates physics in all known dimensions.

plotholes.title: THE JUDGMENT BY WEIRWOOD // ASH AND BONE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THEON'S FATE AT THE CROFTER'S VILLAGE
plotholes.plotHole: Theon's Fate at the Crofter's Village
plotholes.desc: Stannis keeps Theon hung from the wall by iron fetters while debating Northern jurisprudence in negative 40 degree weather.

plotholes.title: THE FALCON SOARS // SWEETROBIN'S SEED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: SWEETROBIN SURVIVED THE SWEETSLEEP
plotholes.desc: Maester Colemon kept prescribing lethal neurological narcotics to an epileptic child because Petyr asked nicely.

plotholes.title: THE FORSAKEN // BOUND TO THE PROW OF SILENCE
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE FORSAKEN TWOW CHAPTER
plotholes.desc: Tying every septon and holy man on the continent to ship prows to cast an oceanic blood spell is peak fantasy metal.

plotholes.title: INK AND BLOOD // THE SECOND SONS FLIPPED
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: TYRION FLIPS THE SECOND SONS IN TWOW
plotholes.plotHole: Tyrion Flips the Second Sons in TWOW
plotholes.desc: Tyrion signed sixty promissory notes in blood for millions of gold dragons backed by Casterly Rock which he doesn't own.

plotholes.title: THE DRAGON HAS THREE HEADS // SADDLES OF VALYRIA
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: TYRION DRAGON RIDER THEORY
plotholes.desc: Tyrion's childhood obsession with dragons and horse saddles was foreshadowed 30 years ago and has yet to pay off.

plotholes.title: THE SMOKING ARM // BLOOD ON SLAVER'S BAY
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: VICTARION'S BATTLE OF MEEREEN ARRIVAL
plotholes.desc: Victarion sailed halfway around the world in full plate armor with a smoking black arm healed by a red priest.

plotholes.title: THE ROOTS OF TIME // THE TREE SPEAKS
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE WEIRWOOD TIME-WHISPER
plotholes.desc: The ancient magical trees have high-speed temporal broadband allowing a paralyzed boy to whisper in his dead father's ear.

plotholes.title: THE FLAYED MAN FALLS // GATES OF WINTERFELL
plotholes.subtitle: PLUGGED: THE LIBERATION OF WINTERFELL
plotholes.desc: Decades of fan speculation concluded in a single choice.
